description:
What the Ask call returns (A18/A19). Code, not the model, decides what the user finally sees:
grounded=False or no (valid) citation -> the fixed 'policy is not clear' fallback in the chosen language.

answer.description: Plain-language answer in the requested language; empty string when grounded is false

citations.description: page + clause copied from source objects in the policy JSON; empty when grounded is false

clause.description: Clause / section number or heading, e.g. '4.2' or 'Exclusions'

page.description: 1-based page number from the [Page N] marker

grounded.description: true only if the policy JSON states the answer AND at least one source is cited
